plainTranslation: You see each other haloed. Inspiring, romantic, blurry. The risk is loving the idea, not the person. Beautiful and unclear. Reality-check who's actually there.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
